title: Loved Liliia in Barcelona!
text: We have been to Barcelona 3 times.  And, it was our 52 yr old daughter’s first time.  Our fabulous guide showed us so many NEW things and, balanced it with fascinating sites for our daughter.  Liliia was our excellent guide.  Liliia speaks 3 languages.  She is very bright and so kind.  I would highly recommend her.  On anyone’s next visit to Barcelona, you should be so fortunate to get Liliia as your guide.
author: Deb_S

title: Good Time!
text: My sister and I thoroughly enjoyed this tour.   Our tour guide Jordi was very knowledgeable and personable.  We had a couple of unexpected treats along way, which were delicious.  We highly recommend this tour and Jordi.
author: Jvonne_T

title: Wonderful Walking Tour of Barcelona.
text: Lucy did a great job. She was flexible re the time and showed us around great local highlights.  Showed us an amazing view of the city, spoke about local architecture and unique cafes. A great tour. Highly recommend.
author: CarolAnn_B

title: Jordi was our guide and...
text: Jordi was our guide and he did an excellent job giving us 3hours of information about Barcelona’s history. His English was perfect and very engaging to hear all the interesting stories!
author: Heidi_T

title: Great Walking Tour of Old Town Barcelona
text: Loved this tour!  We met up with Alan, our tour guide, near the Wax Museum.  From there he gave us a private tour of the old town of Barcelona.  This tour went with his history of the area and Catalonia and the many changes brought about by influences from different countries/cultures.  As we walked through the narrow streets of the Gothic Quarter, he was able to take us in some shops that have preserved historical features like an ancient Jewish bathhouse.  Alan made the history come to life as he showed us locations and maps and brought the whole story together.  The tour was about 3 hours a
author: Robin_M

title: A wonderful walk with Emma - do it!
text: The best way to get to know a city! We did our tour with Emma on the last day of our visit to Barcelona, and I wish the schedule had worked out for us to do it on the first day instead! Emma was friendly, engaging, and super-knowledgeable.  She tailored the walk to our interests and showed us out-of-the-way places we'd never have found on our own, even in the middle of the city's busiest areas!
author: Eluzabeth_F

title: Great Hidden Gems Tour with Jordi.
text: Jordi was an excellent guide. We stayed in the Gothic Quarter and had walked around the area the day before our tour. We would have missed so much if we hadn’t taken the tour. So many things were pointed out by Jordi during our tour. He was very engaging and informative. Having grown up in the area (he even had home movies of him and his family when he was little) we got another perspective on Barcelona. Highly recommend.
author: Howard_L

title: Great introduction to Barcelona!
text: I had a great time with guide Felipe. He was an excellent guide, full of information, facts and stories.  I learned so much about the beautiful city of Barcelona. The 3 hours flew by, but we were able to cover a lot of ground.  I highly recommend this tour and guide.
author: virginia_b

title: Gothic Centre Tour
text: This was so much more than a “sights and sounds” tour. Alan provided historical context and little tidbits of information as well as a great overview of Barcelona. What a fantastic day!!
author: Carmelle_S

title: Great tour
text: We enjoyed this hidden gem tour. Our tour guide was amazing and very informative. We would highly recommend!
author: Sheri_N
